name: Diamond
howToGet: Mine diamond ore or deepslate diamond ore with an iron pickaxe or better - generates from Y=16 down to bedrock, peaking around Y=-59
Loot chests in shipwrecks, buried treasure, mineshafts, bastions, end cities and strongholds
Craft from a block of diamond (9 per block)

Trade to armorer, toolsmith and weaponsmith villagers for emeralds

renewable: Non-renewable as a raw item (no farm produces it), but diamond gear is renewable through villager trading.

keywords: diamond how to find minecraft y level fortune

name: Netherite Ingot

Craft lodestone (8 chiseled stone bricks + 1 ingot)
renewable: Non-renewable: ancient debris does not regenerate and no farm produces it.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Ancient debris never generates exposed to air, so strip mining or bed/TNT blasting at Y=15 is the standard method.
keywords: netherite ingot ancient debris how to get y level upgrade smithing

Craft a block of iron (9 ingots) for beacons and iron golems

keywords: iron ingot how to get farm iron golem minecraft

howToGet: Kill endermen: 0-1 pearls, up to 4 with Looting III
Trade with expert cleric villagers: 5 emeralds per pearl
Barter gold ingots with piglins (small chance, 2-4 pearls)
Loot stronghold altar chests

keywords: ender pearl how to get enderman farm cleric trade teleport

Craft the brewing stand itself (1 rod + 3 cobblestone)

howToGet: Kill an evoker (woodland mansions and raid waves): always drops exactly 1, unaffected by Looting

keywords: totem of undying evoker raid farm how to get

Kill the ender dragon first to open the gateways to the outer islands
One elytra per end ship - bring ender pearls or blocks for the bridge
uses: Glide: jump and press jump again mid-air to spread your wings; firework rockets boost you

renewable: Not farmable, but effectively unlimited: end cities generate endlessly outward on the outer islands.

keywords: elytra how to find end ship city fly fireworks repair

name: Trident
howToGet: Dropped only by drowned holding a trident - never craftable

Bedrock: 15% of drowned spawn with one, 25% drop chance (+4% per Looting level)

uses: Melee (9 damage) and throwable weapon - it comes back with Loyalty
Exclusive enchantments: Loyalty (returns), Channeling (summons lightning in thunderstorms), Riptide (launches you in water/rain), Impaling (bonus damage vs aquatic mobs)
Riptide tridents are the fastest pre-elytra travel in rain
renewable: Renewable via drowned farms; repair by combining two tridents or with Mending.
editionNote: Drop rates are much better in Bedrock (25% vs 8.5% base). Impaling also differs: in Bedrock it damages any mob touching water or standing in rain; in Java it only affects aquatic mobs.
keywords: trident how to get drowned drop rate riptide channeling loyalty

renewable: Renewable: the Wither can be summoned and killed repeatedly.
editionNote: In Java the nether star cannot be destroyed by explosions and despawns only after 10 minutes; in Bedrock it can be destroyed by explosions - keep it away from the Wither fight.
keywords: nether star wither beacon how to get skull farm

Slime blocks (9 slimeballs) for flying machines, bounce pads and entity launchers
Leads (4 string + 1 slimeball) and magma cream (with blaze powder)

keywords: slimeball how to get slime chunk farm sticky piston

Loot jungle temples, dungeons, mineshafts and trial chambers
